qualification: Fourteen valid fixed-size IMA/MS mono/stereo programs group several samples in one AVI chunk;the old source interprets dwLength3 as chunk count and refuses1/2-chunk programs. Generic AVI parsing already preserves raw chunk/index bytes. Four plain controls decode independent literal predictor PCM and8 worker target variants. Baseline4 passed/4 ignored;all4 forced acceptance gates fail at the exact record-count admission.

Private logical-block views expose one independently coded ADPCM block per packet without changing raw container/index addresses. dwLength is checked against total blocks;logical packet limits are checked before allocating the optional view. One-block chunks and G.711 retain their existing raw-record view. No public signatures or codec arithmetic change.

Fourteen grouped layouts include2+1/1+2/3,nested rec and idx1 with8/16-byte block sizes. Opposite-channel stereo predictor PCM detects byte-stride and channel loss. All18 valid programs retain exact literal PCM and packet clocks;36 actual worker target variants cover requested mid-block seek,rewind and EOF. Encoded seek probes include negative,interior,end,beyond-end and i64MAX targets.

Seek intentionally preserves the existing block-rounded landing contract. The initial test oracle wrongly expected sample clipping at1.25ms instead of the declared1.125ms block landing;only the oracle was repaired,and its failure/source are archived. This is not an exact-seek improvement or extra ID.

Every grouped case accepts exact logical packet budget3 and refuses budget2 specifically. After feature admission,the4 malformed controls assert actual partial-block or declared-block-count contradictions rather than the former unrelated grouping refusal.

The obsolete unit requiring exactly one block per chunk now targets a truly nonintegral1016-byte block in a1024-byte record. Existing count/clock values remain asserted with block terminology;no negative tests were skipped. Existing G.711 constructor body is byte-identical apart from initializing the new private view to None,and its native container/seek regression passes.

7 focused and18 related integrations,34 related root units,8 core checks,fixture reproduction and player build pass. Owned AVI contains synthetic VP9;the separate Matroska companion is decoded independently. No AVI-video GUI,physical audio-device,full-format or performance qualification is claimed.

Stereo fixtures extended coverage after preserving the earlier mono generator/manifest/logs. All former mono media hashes remain unchanged. Generation is pure,explicit and offline;ordinary tests do not use FFmpeg,network or fixture generation.
counting: One grouped fixed-block AVI ADPCM capability. No extra IDs for codings,channel widths,group/index variants,packet clocks,seek/resource support,tests or harness maintenance.
